descricao_original: A longitudinal section of a nerve fascicle, shows several myelinated axons. Two nodes of Ranvier are visible between adjacent internodes of the myelin sheath. The axon can be seen passing through the nodal region; Schwann cell nuclei are visible between vacuolated-appearing myelin sheaths. 1000x

marcadores.explicacao_original: The myelin sheath is composed of a series of segments called internodes. Each internode consists of multiple, concentric wrappings of the plasma membrane of a single Schwann cell. The myelin membrane is uniquely high in lipid, which provides insulation for the axon and results in increased conduction velocity of the action potential.

marcadores.explicacao_original: The node of Ranvier is a specialized region of the axonal plasma membrane located in the gap between adjacent myelin internodes. The node of Ranvier possesses a high concentration of sodium channels, which propagate the action potential.
